nodes.text: P A R T 1 The Model
nodes.zh: 模型

nodes.text: An agent whose every visible step is a stored commit, so a process that dies mid-turn is just a pause.
nodes.zh: 每一个可见步骤都是一次存储的提交，因此进程在轮次中途死去，不过是一次暂停。

nodes.text: 1 . 1 What Pi Durable is for
nodes.zh: 1.1 Pi Durable 要解决什么

nodes.text: An agent process can die at any instruction; Pi Durable makes every visible step a stored commit, so a death mid-turn is a pause, not a loss.
nodes.zh: 智能体进程可能在任意一条指令处死去；Pi Durable 让每一个可见步骤都成为一次存储的提交，因此轮次中途的死亡只是一次暂停，而不是丢失。

nodes.text: Your agent is halfway through a deploy tool when the laptop lid closes. When the process comes back, what did it finish? Pi Durable records what it knew before the interruption. The tool’s replay policy decides whether to run it again or report that it may have partially run. This section shows what goes wrong without it, the three moves it makes, and what it deliberately does not do.
nodes.zh: 你的智能体正执行到部署工具的一半时，笔记本合上了盖子。进程回来时，它究竟完成了什么？Pi Durable 记录下中断之前它已经知道的内容。这个工具的重放策略决定是重新运行它，还是报告它可能只执行了一部分。本节说明没有它会出什么问题、它做的三个动作，以及它刻意不做的事。

nodes.text: The problem: a turn has four kinds of state
nodes.zh: 问题：一个轮次有四类状态

nodes.text: Agent processes die for ordinary reasons: a deploy replaces them, the kernel kills them for memory, a laptop sleeps. A death in the middle of a turn catches four kinds of state in flight:
nodes.zh: 智能体进程死于平常的原因：一次部署把它们替换掉，内核因为内存把它们杀掉，笔记本进入睡眠。轮次中途的死亡，会让四类状态都停在半途：

nodes.text: the transcript, the messages so far;
nodes.zh: 记录（transcript），即到目前为止的消息；

nodes.text: the model call, a response half streamed;
nodes.zh: 模型调用，即流式输出到一半的响应；

nodes.text: the tool call, an effect half done;
nodes.zh: 工具调用，即做了一半的效果；

nodes.text: the application state, such as a todo list the tools were updating.
nodes.zh: 应用状态，例如工具正在更新的待办列表。

nodes.text: Each lives somewhere different. After the crash they disagree, and nothing records how far each one got. Earendil’s announcement names the goal: agents that survive crashes, redeploys and outages, and resume interrupted work instead of restarting it earendil.com/posts/pi-durable.
nodes.zh: 它们各自待在不同的地方。崩溃之后它们彼此不一致，而且没有任何东西记录各自推进到了哪里。Earendil 的公告给出了目标：能在崩溃、重新部署和故障中存活，并恢复被中断的工作而不是从头重来的智能体 `earendil.com/posts/pi-durable`。

nodes.text: What original Pi keeps
nodes.zh: 原版 Pi 保留了什么

nodes.text: The Pi coding agent already persists its sessions. A session is a JSONL file under ~/.pi/agent/sessions/. Each line is one JSON object with a type; the first is a session header, and the rest are entries that form a tree through id and parentId coding- agent docs/session-format.md. The tree gives Pi in-place branching: /tree moves to an earlier entry without erasing the branch you leave coding-agent docs/sessions.md. Lines are appended as the agent loop produces them. A user message, an assistant message with its tool calls, and a tool result are each one message line session-format.md §Entry Types. The loop records a response once the provider has finished streaming it, then runs each tool call and records the results coding-agent docs/how-pi-works.md §Agent loop. That design keeps the conversation. It does not keep the turn. If the process dies while a tool runs, the file ends at the assistant message that called it. No line says the tool started or what it printed. A half-streamed response is not in the file, and state an extension held only in memory is gone. The next process can read the conversation back, but it cannot tell whether the tool’s effect happened.
nodes.zh: Pi 编码智能体已经会持久化它的各个 Session。一个 Session 是 `~/.pi/agent/sessions/` 下的一个 `JSONL` 文件。每一行是一个带 `type` 的 JSON 对象；第一行是 Session 头，其余是通过 `id` 和 `parentId` 组成一棵树的条目 `coding-agent docs/session-format.md`。这棵树给了 Pi 原地分支的能力：`/tree` 可以移动到更早的条目，而不抹掉你离开的那条分支 `coding-agent docs/sessions.md`。各行随着智能体循环产出而追加。一条用户消息、一条带工具调用的助手消息、以及一条工具结果，各自都是一行消息 `session-format.md §Entry Types`。循环在供应商流式输出完成之后记录响应，然后逐个运行工具调用并记录结果 `coding-agent docs/how-pi-works.md §Agent loop`。这个设计保住了会话，但保不住轮次。如果进程在工具运行期间死去，文件就停在调用它的那条助手消息上。没有任何一行说明工具开始了，或者它打印了什么。流式输出到一半的响应不在文件里，扩展只存在内存中的状态也没了。下一个进程能把会话读回来，但无法判断工具的效果是否已经发生。

nodes.title:
A CRASH IN THE MIDDLE OF A TOOL CALL
C O M P A R I S O N
nodes.caption: A crash mid-tool leaves original Pi a file that ends at the call; Pi Durable reopens an interrupted task. Left of the dashed line is what was written before
nodes.zh_caption: 工具执行中途崩溃，会让原版 Pi 留下一个停在调用处的文件；Pi Durable 则重新打开一个被中断的任务。虚线左侧是崩溃之前已写入的内容

nodes.text: A crash mid-tool leaves original Pi a file that ends at the call; Pi Durable reopens an interrupted task. Left of the dashed line is what was written before SIGKILL; right is what the next process finds. The Pi Durable rows are conversation 1 of the crash run in research/capture/crash-*.txt, where deploy printed 6 of its 10 lines. The original Pi row follows session-format.md.
nodes.zh: 工具执行中途崩溃，会让原版 Pi 留下一个停在调用处的文件；Pi Durable 则重新打开一个被中断的任务。虚线左侧是 `SIGKILL` 之前已写入的内容，右侧是下一个进程看到的内容。Pi Durable 那些行是 `research/capture/crash-*.txt` 中崩溃运行的会话 1，其中 `deploy` 打印了 10 行中的 6 行。原版 Pi 那一行遵循 `session-format.md`。

nodes.text: Pi Durable’s answer
nodes.zh: Pi Durable 的答案

nodes.text: Pi Durable is a harness: one open storage plus the machinery that runs agents on it. It makes three moves, and each closes one of the gaps above. Everything visible is committed — “Conversations, model turns, tool calls, and your own state are committed to storage before anything is shown” README. A half-streamed answer and a tool’s running output are committed too, with a default minimum interval of 100 ms between progress commits. A crash loses progress since the last successful commit; storage delays and output pacing can make that gap longer README §Watching a Conversation. Work is tasks with checkpoints — a model call and a tool call each run as a task, a durable state machine that commits a checkpoint at every step. A tool task commits its intent, the final arguments and a replay policy, before execute() runs src/harness/tool.ts. On reopen the harness knows exactly which calls had started. App state is documents in the same commit — a document is typed JSON stored next to the transcript. It changes in the same atomic commit as the entries, so a todo list can never be ahead of the message that changed it README §Your Own State. The crash run shows the result. A second process reopened the SQLite file. Opening alone turned the running tool task back to pending. On resume(), the deploy tool, which was not declared safe to rerun, got a pi.tool-result entry holding its six committed lines and an error:
nodes.zh: Pi Durable 是一个 Harness：一处打开的存储，加上在其上运行智能体的机制。它做了三个动作，每个都补上前面某个缺口。所有可见的东西都要提交——「会话、模型轮次、工具调用和你自己的状态，在任何东西被展示之前都已提交到存储」`README`。流式输出到一半的答案和工具运行中的输出同样要提交，进度提交的默认最小间隔是 100 ms。崩溃只会丢失上一次成功提交之后的进展；存储延迟和输出节奏可能把这个间隔拉得更长 `README §Watching a Conversation`。工作就是带检查点的任务——一次模型调用和一次工具调用各自作为一个任务运行，也就是一个在每一步提交检查点的持久状态机。工具任务在 `execute()` 运行之前提交它的意图、最终参数和一条重放策略 `src/harness/tool.ts`。重新打开时，Harness 确切知道哪些调用已经开始。应用状态是同一次提交里的文档——文档是存在记录（transcript）旁边的带类型的 JSON。它与条目在同一次原子提交中改变，因此待办列表永远不会跑到修改它的那条消息前面 `README §Your Own State`。那次崩溃运行展示了结果。第二个进程重新打开了 `SQLite` 文件。仅是打开就把运行中的工具任务变回了 `pending`。在 `resume()` 时，`deploy` 工具没有被声明为可安全重跑，于是得到了一条 `pi.tool-result` 条目，里面是它已提交的那六行和一条错误：

nodes.text: tool result written on resume, excerpt research/capture/crash-after.txt JSON
nodes.zh: 恢复时写入的工具结果，节选自 `research/capture/crash-after.txt` `JSON`

lines: "text": "<harness>\n[error] Tool deploy was interrupted and may have partially run\n</harness>" } ],

nodes.text: The model message of entry 25. The first text block, cut here, holds all six output lines from the killed process. The entry’s data.diagnostics carries the same error with code: "interrupted".
nodes.zh: 条目 25 的模型消息。第一个文本块（此处截断）包含被杀死进程的全部六行输出。该条目的 `data.diagnostics` 带有同样的错误，`code` 为 `"interrupted"`。

nodes.text: The model then read that result and answered, and the input settled done. In the same crash, a fetch_report tool declared replay: "safe" simply ran again from step 1 in the new process research/capture/crash-README.md. The next process did not guess. It read a checkpoint that said “this effect may have happened” and applied a policy chosen in advance. The effect sandwich (p. 70) and tool calls and replay (p. 94) take that apart.
nodes.zh: 随后模型读了这条结果并给出答案，输入结算为 `done`。在同一次崩溃中，声明了 `replay: "safe"` 的 `fetch_report` 工具在新进程里直接从第 1 步重新跑了一遍 `research/capture/crash-README.md`。下一个进程并没有猜。它读到的是一个写着「这个效果可能已经发生」的检查点，然后套用事先选定的策略。效果三明治（p. 70）与工具调用和重放（p. 94）会把它拆开讲。

nodes.text: What it is not
nodes.zh: 它不是什么

nodes.text: The scope is narrow on purpose. Three limits matter from the start. One process per storage — “One process owns a storage at a time; there is no cross-process locking” README §Storage. A Harness is not a cluster scheduler. Supervising and restarting the process is the host’s job. No multi-writer merge — the spec lists “CRDT/offline multi-writer merge” among its non-goals spec §13. Many clients may watch and steer one conversation, but every write goes through one Harness.
nodes.zh: 作用域是刻意收窄的。有三条限制从一开始就很重要。每个存储只有一个进程——「一个存储在同一时刻只归一个进程所有；不存在跨进程锁」`README §Storage`。Harness 不是集群调度器。监督和重启进程是宿主的事。没有多写入方合并——规范把「`CRDT`／离线多写入方合并」列为非目标 `spec §13`。许多客户端可以观察并引导一个会话，但每一次写入都经过同一个 Harness。

nodes.text: No rollback of the world — a commit is atomic in storage only. External effects “do not run inside the Session mutation transaction” spec §1, invariant 4. When the harness cannot know whether a payment went through, it says so and leaves the answer to an idempotency key or a remote record (limits and non-goals (p. 168)).
nodes.zh: 不提供对世界的回滚——提交只在存储范围内是原子的。外部效果「不在 `Session` 的变更事务内运行」`spec §1`，不变式 4。当 Harness 无法知道一笔支付是否已经发生时，它会如实说明，并把答案交给幂等键或远端记录（边界与非目标（p. 168））。

nodes.text: Reopen the same storage and resume unfinished work. Safe tools can run again; unsafe tools report an interrupted result. Decide, per tool, whether running it twice is safe. That one choice decides what happens to a call that was cut off. Keep app state in documents, not in memory, so it can never disagree with the transcript. Keep one process per storage, and let your supervisor restart it.
nodes.zh: 重新打开同一个存储，恢复未完成的工作。安全的工具可以再次运行；不安全的工具报告一个被中断的结果。逐个工具决定运行两次是否安全。这一个选择就决定了被截断的调用会怎样。把应用状态放在文档里，而不是内存里，这样它永远不会与记录（transcript）不一致。每个存储保持一个进程，让你的监督者去重启它。

(ToolTask phases call, execute); research/capture/crash-README.md, crash-before.txt, crash-reopen-tasks.txt, crash-after.txt; research/pi/packages/coding-agent/docs/session-format.md, sessions.md, how-pi-works.md; earendil.com/posts/pi-durable (Earendil, October 2026)

nodes.title:
THE LAYERS OF A HARNESS
L A Y E R S
nodes.caption: The host drives a Harness, the Harness commits through one Session, and the Session writes one storage. The right column is HarnessOptions; Chord is a package dependency, not an option. After src/harness/harness.ts and src/session/session.ts.
nodes.zh_caption: 宿主驱动一个 Harness，Harness 通过一个 `Session` 提交，`Session` 写入一处存储。右列是 `HarnessOptions`；`Chord` 是一个包依赖，不是选项。依据 `src/harness/harness.ts` 与 `src/session/session.ts`。

nodes.text: 1 . 2 The architecture in one page
nodes.zh: 1.2 一页讲完架构

nodes.text: A Harness is a Session kernel with conversations, submissions and a task scheduler on top, one storage underneath, and everything else plugged in by
nodes.zh: Harness 就是一个 `Session` 内核，上面加上面话、提交项和任务调度器，下面垫着一处存储，其余一切由

nodes.text: the host.
nodes.zh: 宿主插入。

nodes.text: Think of the package as a stack. Your program asks the Harness to do things; the Harness turns every request into a commit; one storage keeps the commits. This section names each layer, says which state each one owns, and shows what lives only in memory and is rebuilt when a process restarts.
nodes.zh: 把这个包想象成一个栈。你的程序让 Harness 做事；Harness 把每个请求变成一次提交；一处存储保管这些提交。本节为每一层命名，说明每一层各自拥有哪些状态，并展示哪些东西只存在于内存中、在进程重启时被重建。

nodes.text: Four layers
nodes.zh: 四层

nodes.text: The package stacks four layers. Your process, the host, sits on top and calls the Harness. The Harness turns those calls into commits on one Session. The Session writes each commit to one storage. Code the harness runs but does not own, such as extensions, models and the execution environment, is passed in by the host when it opens the Harness.
nodes.zh: 这个包叠了四层。你的进程，也就是宿主，位于顶层并调用 Harness。Harness 把这些调用变成某个 `Session` 上的提交。`Session` 把每次提交写入一处存储。Harness 运行但不拥有的代码——例如扩展、模型和执行环境——由宿主在打开 Harness 时传入。

nodes.text: The host drives a Harness, the Harness commits through one Session, and the Session writes one storage. The right column is HarnessOptions; Chord is a package dependency, not an option. After src/harness/harness.ts and src/session/session.ts.
nodes.zh: 宿主驱动一个 Harness，Harness 通过一个 `Session` 提交，`Session` 写入一处存储。右列是 `HarnessOptions`；`Chord` 是一个包依赖，不是选项。依据 `src/harness/harness.ts` 与 `src/session/session.ts`。

nodes.text: Storage — a backend that stores records and documents and commits a batch of writes atomically. Three ship with the package README §Storage; Part 9 covers the storage contract (p. 141). Session — the kernel. It “owns one mutation line, conversations, entries, tasks, submissions, and documents” spec §1. The mutation line is a queue that runs one commit at a time. The Session also keeps one tracker per loaded document and publishes each commit to its observers src/session/session.ts. You can use it alone through createSession(); examples 00 to 05 do. Harness — the Session kernel “extended with conversation handles and a registry” src/harness/harness.ts. It adds the handles you call, the submission machinery, the task scheduler, and the views.
nodes.zh: `Storage`——一个存储记录与文档、并把一批写入原子提交的后端。随包附带三种 `README §Storage`；第 9 部分讲存储契约（p. 141）。`Session`——内核。它「拥有一条变更线、会话、条目、任务、提交项和文档」`spec §1`。变更线是一个一次只跑一次提交的队列。`Session` 还为每个已加载文档维护一个追踪器，并把每次提交发布给它的观察者 `src/session/session.ts`。你可以通过 `createSession()` 单独使用它；示例 00 到 05 就是这么做的。`Harness`——被「扩展了会话句柄和注册表」的 `Session` 内核 `src/harness/harness.ts`。它加上你要调用的句柄、提交项机制、任务调度器和各种视图。

nodes.text: Inside the Harness
nodes.zh: Harness 内部

nodes.text: Four components do the Harness’s work, each in its own file under src/harness/.
nodes.zh: 四个组件承担 Harness 的工作，每个都在 `src/harness/` 下的一个文件里。

lines: harness.ts nothing: a handle is an id plus methods; “compare handles by id” README §Concepts

nodes.text: Conversation handles Submissions submissions.ts, inbox.ts admission of inputs and writes, the per-conversation inbox, and the waiters behind wait() Task scheduler scheduler.ts an in-memory mirror of every live task; reserving, running and aborting them Views view.ts, task-graph.ts, events.ts viewState(), watch(), the task graph and agent events
nodes.zh: 会话句柄｜提交项 `submissions.ts`、`inbox.ts`：输入与写入的受理、每个会话各自的收件箱，以及 `wait()` 背后的等待者｜任务调度器 `scheduler.ts`：每个存活任务的内存镜像；预留、运行和中止它们｜视图 `view.ts`、`task-graph.ts`、`events.ts`：`viewState()`、`watch()`、任务图和智能体事件

nodes.text: The harness answers inputs with three built-in tasks. pi.generation prepares the prompt and calls the model. pi.tool runs one tool call. pi.compaction summarizes old context spec §8. They “are not an extension and cannot be removed or replaced” src/harness/registry.ts, so always build the registry with createRegistry(); Harness.open() refuses one that lacks them.
nodes.zh: Harness 用三个内置任务来回应输入。`pi.generation` 准备提示词并调用模型。`pi.tool` 运行一次工具调用。`pi.compaction` 概括旧上下文 `spec §8`。它们「不是扩展，不能被移除或替换」`src/harness/registry.ts`，所以永远用 `createRegistry()` 构建注册表；`Harness.open()` 会拒绝缺少它们的注册表。

nodes.text: What the host plugs in
nodes.zh: 宿主插入的东西

nodes.text: Harness.open(storage, options, context) takes everything else as HarnessOptions spec §2.2.
nodes.zh: `Harness.open(storage, options, context)` 把其余一切都作为 `HarnessOptions` 接收 `spec §2.2`。

lines: models the pi-ai Models interface; generation calls models.streamSimple() generation (p. 91)
registry the installed extensions: tools, prompt sections, hooks, wraps and tasks the registry (p. 103)

nodes.text: settings run policy read at every use and never stored settings and defaults (p. 180) env builds the ExecutionEnv for each tool call and prompt render the environment (p. 155) conversationCreated runs in every commit that creates or forks a conversation access and creation (p. 53) now, onReport the clock, and a sink for errors the harness reports but survives —
nodes.zh: `settings`：每次使用时读取、从不存储的运行策略｜设置与默认值（p. 180）｜`env`：为每次工具调用和提示词渲染构建 `ExecutionEnv`｜渲染环境（p. 155）｜`conversationCreated`：在每次创建或分叉会话的提交中运行｜访问与创建（p. 53）｜`now`、`onReport`：时钟，以及 Harness 报告但能挺过去的错误的去处——

nodes.text: Two dependencies are not options: @earendil-works/pi-ai supplies the message types and the faux provider, and @earendil-works/chord supplies document state package.json. Every async call takes a Chord Context; cancelling it cancels the wait, never the work README §Quick Start.
nodes.zh: 有两个依赖不是选项：`@earendil-works/pi-ai` 提供消息类型和 faux 供应商，`@earendil-works/chord` 提供文档状态 `package.json`。每个异步调用都接受一个 `Chord Context`；取消它取消的是等待，而不是工作 `README §Quick Start`。

nodes.text: One call through the layers
nodes.zh: 一次调用穿过各层

nodes.text: Follow root.submit(input, context) down the stack to see how the layers divide the work. 1. The Conversation handle passes the input to the Submissions component src/harness/submissions.ts. 2. Submissions makes one commit. It appends the user entry, records the submission, creates the first generation task, and marks the conversation busy in its pi.live document.
nodes.zh: 沿着 `root.submit(input, context)` 往下走，看各层如何分工。1. 会话句柄把输入交给提交项组件 `src/harness/submissions.ts`。2. 提交项组件发起一次提交。它追加用户条目、记录提交项、创建第一个生成任务，并在会话的 `pi.live` 文档中把它标记为忙碌。

nodes.text: 3. The Session writes that commit to storage, and only then tells its listeners about it src/session/session.ts. 4. The scheduler is one of those listeners. It sees the new task and claims it for running. Claiming is another commit
nodes.zh: 3. `Session` 把那次提交写入存储，然后才通知它的监听者 `src/session/session.ts`。4. 调度器就是这些监听者之一。它看到新任务并认领它去运行。认领本身又是一次提交

nodes.text: src/harness/scheduler.ts.
nodes.zh: `src/harness/scheduler.ts`。

nodes.text: 5. The task runs outside any commit. It calls the model through models, and every result it wants to keep goes back in as a new
nodes.zh: 5. 任务在任何提交之外运行。它通过 `models` 调用模型，它想保留的每个结果都作为一次新的

nodes.text: commit.
nodes.zh: 提交写回去。

nodes.text: No layer reaches around another, and the scheduler learns about new work only from published commits. The life of one answered input (p. 19) walks the chain with real records.
nodes.zh: 没有哪一层绕过另一层，调度器只从已发布的提交中得知新工作。一个被回应的输入的一生（p. 19）用真实记录走完这条链。

nodes.text: Memory and storage
nodes.zh: 内存与存储

nodes.text: The split between memory and storage is the key to the whole package. Storage holds the truth. Memory holds a working set that is always rebuilt from it: Live tasks — the scheduler “mirrors every committed non-terminal task record” src/harness/scheduler.ts. On open it loads them all and turns any task left running by a dead process back to pending, in one commit. Loaded documents — a cache of documents already read src/session/session.ts. Waiters and watches — the promises behind wait() and the subscriptions behind views; the next process creates them again. If the process dies, nothing in that list matters: open reads it all back. “Reopening the storage picks the work up where it stopped” README.
nodes.zh: 内存与存储的划分是整个包的关键。存储持有真相。内存持有的是一份始终从真相重建的工作集：存活的任务——调度器「镜像每个已提交的非终态任务记录」`src/harness/scheduler.ts`，打开时它把它们全部载入，并在一次提交中把任何被死掉进程留下的运行中任务变回 `pending`。已加载的文档——已读文档的一份缓存 `src/session/session.ts`。等待者与观察——`wait()` 背后的 promise 和视图背后的订阅；下一个进程会重新创建它们。如果进程死去，这份清单里的东西都无关紧要：打开会把它们全都读回来。「重新打开存储会从停下的地方接着做」`README`。

nodes.zh: 入口点

nodes.title:
THE COMMIT AS THE ONLY DOOR
F L O W
nodes.caption: Every visible change passes through one commit on the mutation line; effects reach observers only as commits. Stage names follow spec §4: the line is held from the callback through publication.
nodes.zh_caption: 每一个可见的改变，都要经过变更线上的同一次提交；效果只以提交的形式抵达观察者。阶段名称遵循 `spec §4`：变更线从回调一直持有到发布。

nodes.text: 1 . 3 The core rule and its invariants
nodes.zh: 1.3 核心规则及其不变式

nodes.text: One sentence defines the system: commit everything together, and show nothing that is not committed. Eight invariants make that sentence true.
nodes.zh: 一句话定义了这个系统：所有东西一起提交，不展示任何未提交的东西。八条不变式让这句话成立。

nodes.text: The whole design fits in one idea: nothing counts until it is committed. A commit is an atomic save: everything in it is stored together, or nothing is. If your screen shows it, a crash cannot take it back. This section states that rule, defines the terms the rest of the book uses, and explains the eight guarantees that make the rule hold.
nodes.zh: 整个设计只容纳一个想法：没有提交的东西就不算数。提交是一次原子保存：其中的一切要么一起存下，要么都不存。如果你的屏幕显示了出来，崩溃就收不回它。本节陈述这条规则，定义全书其余部分使用的术语，并解释让这条规则成立的八项保证。

nodes.text: The rule
nodes.zh: 规则

nodes.text: The spec states the whole design in two sentences, before any type:
nodes.zh: 规范在给出任何类型之前，用两句话陈述了整个设计：

nodes.text: “A Session atomically commits immutable entries, full task records, and Chord-tracked documents. Only committed state is observable.”
nodes.zh: 「`Session` 原子地提交不可变条目、完整任务记录和由 `Chord` 跟踪的文档。只有已提交的状态是可观测的。」

nodes.text: The first sentence says what a commit holds: transcript records, task records and document changes, written as one unit. The second says that nothing else can be seen. A screen, a waiter, a watch and the scheduler itself all read committed state, and there is no side channel spec, preamble. Read it as a door: every change goes through the commit, and every observer sits behind it.
nodes.zh: 第一句说明一次提交包含什么：记录、任务记录和文档变更，作为一个整体写入。第二句说明别的什么都看不见。屏幕、等待者、观察以及调度器本身，读的都是已提交的状态，而且不存在旁路 `spec`，前言。把它读成一扇门：每个改变都从提交通过，每个观察者都坐在门的另一侧。

lines: Every visible change passes through one commit on the mutation line; effects reach observers only as commits. Stage names follow spec §4: the line is held from the callback through publication.

nodes.text: The terms
nodes.zh: 术语

nodes.text: The spec defines its nouns once, in §1. The rest of the book uses them exactly this way. Session — owns one mutation line, conversations, entries, tasks, submissions, and documents. Conversation — a transcript scope. It may fork another conversation. Entry — an immutable transcript record. Task — a durable state machine attached to one conversation. Document — your application’s JSON state, saved with the conversation or task. Definition — the TypeScript declaration that names a document and sets its initial value and storage rules. Source — a read-only stream of saved document updates. Turn — one assistant response and the tool calls it makes. Run — the sequence of turns from an admitted input to the final answer. A conversation is busy while a run is active.
nodes.zh: 规范在 §1 里一次性定义了它的名词。全书其余部分都严格按这个方式使用它们。`Session`——拥有一条变更线、会话、条目、任务、提交项和文档。`Conversation`（会话）——一个记录（transcript）作用域。它可以分叉出另一个会话。`Entry`（条目）——一条不可变的记录。`Task`（任务）——挂在某个会话上的持久状态机。`Document`（文档）——你的应用的 JSON 状态，随会话或任务一起保存。`Definition`——为文档命名并设定其初始值与存储规则的 TypeScript 声明。`Source`——文档更新保存后形成的只读流。`Turn`（轮次）——一次助手响应及其发起的工具调用。`Run`（运行）——从一个被受理的输入到最终答案之间的轮次序列。运行进行期间，会话就是忙碌的。

nodes.text: The eight invariants
nodes.zh: 八条不变式

nodes.text: Spec §1 then lists eight “required invariants”. Each one closes a specific failure. The table quotes them in short form; the paragraphs below say what each one buys.
nodes.zh: 接着规范 §1 列出八条「必需的不变式」。每一条都堵住一种具体的失效。表格以短形式引用它们；下面的段落说明每一条换来了什么。

nodes.text: 1 One commit is atomic across all record and document writes. a tool call stored without its task 2 A document update is published only after its storage commit succeeds. a screen shows state a crash erases 3 All visible progress is durable; no volatile publication path. streamed text that never existed after reopen 4 External effects do not run inside the mutation transaction. one slow call stalls every conversation 5 Entries and IDs are immutable and never reused. references point at the wrong record 6 Drafts are revoked when the callback settles; values are copied, strict JSON. writes that bypass the commit 7 The line is held through settlement and adoption; user callbacks run later, off it. a commit built on unadopted state 8 An uncertain storage failure is fatal to the open Session. memory and disk silently diverge
nodes.zh:
1 一次提交在所有记录和文档写入上是原子的。｜被存下却没有任务的工具调用
2 文档更新只有在其存储提交成功后才发布。｜屏幕显示的状态被崩溃抹掉
3 所有可见进展都是持久的；不存在易失的发布路径。｜重开之后从未存在过的流式文本
4 外部效果不在变更事务内运行。｜一个慢调用拖住每一个会话
5 条目与 ID 不可变且永不复用。｜引用指向错误的记录
6 草稿在回调结算时被撤销；值是复制的严格 JSON。｜绕过提交的写入
7 变更线在结算与采纳期间保持持有；用户回调稍后在线外运行。｜建立在未采纳状态上的提交
8 不确定的存储失败对已打开的 `Session` 是致命的。｜内存与磁盘悄悄分叉

nodes.text: 1 · Atomic across records and documents A commit is one call to Storage.commit(writes), and it either stores every write or none src/session/session.ts. In the one- turn capture, commit 6 writes the assistant entry with the tool call, moves generation 9 to waiting, creates tool task 12, and updates two documents. Split across two writes, a crash between them would leave a tool call that no task will ever run.
nodes.zh: 1 · 跨记录与文档的原子性 一次提交就是对 `Storage.commit(writes)` 的一次调用，它要么存下全部写入，要么一个都不存 `src/session/session.ts`。在单轮次的抓取中，提交 6 写入带工具调用的助手条目、把生成任务 9 移到 `waiting`、创建工具任务 12，并更新两个文档。若拆成两次写入，其间的崩溃会留下一个永远不会有任务来运行的工具调用。

nodes.text: 2 and 3 · Publish after storage, and only then The Session publishes a commit only after Storage.commit() has returned and the new revisions are adopted. Invariant 3 removes the alternative: there is no way to show something without committing it. Partial answers and tool output are therefore committed too, throttled by settings.progress. Each of those commits is a storage write; that is the price of a screen that never shows anything a crash can take back src/harness/generation.ts (streamResponse). 4 · Effects stay off the line “External model, process, tool, network, and human effects run outside it” spec §4. Every conversation of a Harness shares one mutation line, so a model call awaited inside a commit would block every other commit until it returned. Worse, the commit’s content would depend on an effect it cannot undo. The tool task shows the pattern: commit the intent, run execute() off the line, then commit the result (the effect sandwich (p. 70)). 5 · Immutable entries, ids never reused All record types share one id space. In the SQLite capture, conversation 1, documents 2 to 6, entry 7, submission 8 and task 9 come from one counter research/capture/sqlite-rows.txt (record_ids). Records point at each other by id: tool task 12’s input is {"assistant": 11, "callId": "call-1"}, and submission 8’s answer is entry 15. If an id could be reused or an entry rewritten, those pointers would silently change meaning. Even an id taken by a commit that faulted stays used research/capture/NOTES.md §6. 6 · Drafts die with their callback Inside a commit, tx.doc() returns a mutable draft. When the callback settles, the Session “synchronously prepares or aborts every open change”, and the draft is revoked. A test keeps a draft past its commit and checks that reading or writing it then throws test/session-documents.test.ts, “revokes escaped drafts”. Without this, a stray reference could change a document outside any commit, breaking the rule. 7 · The line covers storage and adoption The line stays held until storage has settled and the new revision is adopted. The next commit therefore always starts from the state the previous one stored. Commit observers run on the line, but only to capture immutable values. Your watch and document-state callbacks run later, off the line, so a slow UI cannot stall the harness (the commit and the mutation line (p. 29)). 8 · An uncertain failure poisons the Session A storage error that might have written something leaves memory unable to know what disk holds. The Session then refuses every later call with “Session is poisoned by a failed commit after storage admission; reopen it” src/session/session.ts. Only StorageRejected promises that nothing was written, and only it lets the Session continue. Preparation failures, such as a non- JSON value in a draft, happen before storage sees the batch and roll back normally (when a commit fails (p. 33)).
nodes.zh:
2 与 3 · 先落存储，再发布，而且只有如此 `Session` 只有在 `Storage.commit()` 返回、并且新修订被采纳之后，才发布一次提交。不变式 3 排除了另一种可能：没有办法展示某个东西而不先提交它。因此部分答案和工具输出同样要提交，由 `settings.progress` 节流。这些提交每一次都是一次存储写入；这就是「屏幕绝不显示任何崩溃能收走的东西」的代价 `src/harness/generation.ts`（`streamResponse`）。
4 · 效果留在变更线之外「外部的模型、进程、工具、网络和人工效果都在它之外运行」`spec §4`。一个 Harness 的每个会话共享同一条变更线，所以在提交内等待一次模型调用，会阻塞其他所有提交直到它返回。更糟的是，这次提交的内容会依赖一个它无法撤销的效果。工具任务展示了这个模式：提交意图，在变更线之外运行 `execute()`，再提交结果（效果三明治（p. 70））。
5 · 条目不可变，id 永不复用 所有记录类型共享同一个 id 空间。在 `SQLite` 抓取中，会话 1、文档 2 到 6、条目 7、提交项 8 和任务 9 都来自同一个计数器 `research/capture/sqlite-rows.txt`（`record_ids`）。记录之间通过 id 相互指向：工具任务 12 的输入是 `{"assistant": 11, "callId": "call-1"}`，提交项 8 的答案是条目 15。如果 id 可以被复用、或者条目可以被改写，这些指针就会悄悄改变含义。即使一个 id 已被一次故障的提交占用，它也保持被占用 `research/capture/NOTES.md §6`。
6 · 草稿随回调一同消亡 在提交内部，`tx.doc()` 返回一个可变草稿。当回调结算时，`Session`「同步地准备或中止每一个打开的更改」，草稿随之被撤销。一个测试把草稿保留过它的提交，并检查此后读取或写入它会抛错 `test/session-documents.test.ts`，「revokes escaped drafts」。没有这条，一个游离的引用就可能在任何提交之外改动文档，从而破坏规则。
7 · 变更线覆盖存储与采纳 变更线一直保持持有，直到存储结算、并且新修订被采纳。因此下一次提交总是从上一次提交存下的状态开始。提交观察者在线上运行，但只是为了捕获不可变的值。你的 watch 和文档状态回调稍后在线外运行，因此一个缓慢的 UI 拖不住 Harness（提交与变更线（p. 29））。
8 · 不确定的失败会毒化 `Session` 一个可能已经写入了什么的存储错误，会让内存无法知道磁盘上是什么。此后 `Session` 会用「`Session` 已被存储接纳之后的一次失败提交毒化；请重新打开它」拒绝之后的每一次调用 `src/session/session.ts`。只有 `StorageRejected` 承诺没有写入任何东西，也只有它能让 `Session` 继续。准备阶段的失败，例如草稿里出现了非 JSON 值，发生在存储看到这批写入之前，会正常回滚（当提交失败时（p. 33））。

nodes.text: Ask one question of any design: is the state you show or act on committed? If not, it does not exist yet. Change related things in one commit, so a crash can never split them. Never call a model, a tool or the network inside a commit callback. If storage fails in a way that may have written, close and reopen; do not retry.
nodes.zh: 对任何设计都问同一个问题：你展示或据以行动的状态是已提交的吗？如果不是，它就还不存在。在一次提交里改动相关的东西，这样崩溃永远无法把它们拆开。绝不在提交回调内部调用模型、工具或网络。如果存储以一种可能已经写入的方式失败，关闭并重新打开；不要重试。

drafts”, “poisons the Session after an uncertain Storage failure”); research/capture/sqlite-rows.txt, sqlite-commits.txt, NOTES.md §6

nodes.text: 1 . 4 The life of one answered input
nodes.zh: 1.4 一个被回应的输入的一生

nodes.text: One question, one tool call and one answer take seventeen commits, and reading them in order is reading the whole harness.
nodes.zh: 一个问题、一次工具调用和一个答案要用掉十七次提交；按顺序读它们，就是在读整个 Harness。

nodes.text: A user asks “Count to 3.”, the model calls a count tool, and then it answers. That small exchange takes seventeen commits. This section walks through them in order, so you can read any commit log and say who wrote each line, why, and what a crash right there would leave behind.
nodes.zh: 用户问「Count to 3.」，模型调用一个计数工具，然后给出答案。这次小小的往返用掉十七次提交。本节按顺序走过它们，于是你可以读任何提交日志，说出每一行是谁写的、为什么写，以及在那个位置崩溃会留下什么。

nodes.text: The run
nodes.zh: 这次运行

nodes.text: The README’s Quick Start is the smallest host. It opens a Harness over storage, gets the root conversation, submits an input, and waits for the answer:
nodes.zh: `README` 的快速开始是最小的宿主。它在存储之上打开一个 Harness，取得根会话，提交一个输入，然后等待答案：

nodes.text: Quick Start, abridged README.md §Quick Start TS
nodes.zh: 快速开始，节选 `README.md §Quick Start` `TS`

lines: new MemoryStorage(), { models, registry: createRegistry() }, context
{ type: "input", content: "What is the capital of France?" }, context);
// settled.answer is the id of the pi.assistant entry that answered await harness.close(context);

nodes.text: Imports, model setup and reading the answer back are cut. wait() resolves once the input is done or unanswered.
nodes.zh: 导入语句、模型设置以及把答案读回来这几部分被略去。输入完成或没有得到回答之后，`wait()` 就会 resolve。

nodes.text: The capture runs the same steps over SQLite, so every commit can be read back as rows research/capture/scripts/one-turn.ts. The faux model calls a count tool with {n: 3}, then answers “I counted 1, 2, 3.”. The tool prints three lines with api.output() and returns {}. A subscribeCommits() listener logs every commit. Two figures show the run. Each numbered arrow is one commit, and its number is the commit’s seq in storage.
nodes.zh: 这次抓取在 `SQLite` 上跑同样的步骤，于是每次提交都可以作为行读回来 `research/capture/scripts/one-turn.ts`。faux 模型用 `{n: 3}` 调用计数工具，然后回答「I counted 1, 2, 3.」。工具用 `api.output()` 打印三行，并返回 `{}`。一个 `subscribeCommits()` 监听者记录每一次提交。两张图展示了这次运行。每个带编号的箭头就是一次提交，它的编号就是该提交在存储中的 `seq`。

nodes.text: Commits 1–2: a conversation, then an input
nodes.zh: 提交 1–2：一个会话，然后一个输入

nodes.text: root() creates the root conversation in commit 1. The same commit creates its five built-in documents, ids 2 to 6: pi.live, pi.inbox, pi.usage, pi.provider and pi.agent src/harness/harness.ts (conversationCreated). The agent document stores the model choice, faux/faux-1. Opening the Harness also ran a commit, to reconcile running tasks, but it wrote nothing. A commit with no writes is discarded and uses no sequence number src/session/session.ts. submit() is commit 2, and it is the one that makes the input durable. The conversation is idle, so admission does three things in one commit src/harness/submissions.ts (admitSubmission). It appends a pi.user entry, 7. It creates submission 8 with status placed and entry: 7. And it starts a run: it creates generation task 9 and sets pi.live.run to {"taskId": 9, "inputs": [8]}. From here on the conversation is busy, because “busy” is defined as pi.live.run being present (run control (p. 88)). A crash after this commit loses nothing the user typed. Resubmitting with the same requestId returns submission 8 instead of a new one.
nodes.zh: `root()` 在提交 1 中创建根会话。同一次提交还创建了它的五个内置文档，id 2 到 6：`pi.live`、`pi.inbox`、`pi.usage`、`pi.provider` 和 `pi.agent` `src/harness/harness.ts`（`conversationCreated`）。`agent` 文档存放模型选择，这里是 `faux`／`faux-1`。打开 Harness 时也运行了一次提交，用来对齐运行中的任务，但它没有写入任何东西。没有写入的提交会被丢弃，也不占用序列号 `src/session/session.ts`。`submit()` 是提交 2，它是让输入变得持久的那一次。此时会话空闲，于是受理在一次提交里做了三件事 `src/harness/submissions.ts`（`admitSubmission`）。它追加一条 `pi.user` 条目 7。它创建提交项 8，`status` 为 `placed`、`entry` 为 7。它启动一次运行：创建生成任务 9，并把 `pi.live.run` 设为 `{"taskId": 9, "inputs": [8]}`。从这一刻起会话就是忙碌的，因为「忙碌」的定义就是 `pi.live.run` 存在（运行控制（p. 88））。在这次提交之后崩溃，不会丢失用户输入的任何内容。用相同的 `requestId` 重新提交，会返回提交项 8，而不是新建一个。

nodes.title:
ONE ANSWERED INPUT, COMMITS 1–8
S E Q U E N C E
nodes.caption: Commits 1–8 take the input from submit() to a tool call whose intent is durable. From research/capture/sqlite-commits.txt; document operations from research/capture/extra-p1/sqlite-commit-ops.txt.
nodes.zh_caption: 提交 1–8 把输入从 `submit()` 带到一次意图已经持久的工具调用。来自 `research/capture/sqlite-commits.txt`；文档操作来自 `research/capture/extra-p1/sqlite-commit-ops.txt`。

nodes.text: Commits 1–8 take the input from submit() to a tool call whose intent is durable. From research/capture/sqlite-commits.txt; document operations from research/capture/extra-p1/sqlite-commit-ops.txt.
nodes.zh: 提交 1–8 把输入从 `submit()` 带到一次意图已经持久的工具调用。来自 `research/capture/sqlite-commits.txt`；文档操作来自 `research/capture/extra-p1/sqlite-commit-ops.txt`。

nodes.text: Commits 3–6: the first generation
nodes.zh: 提交 3–6：第一次生成

nodes.text: Commit 3 is the scheduler at work. It reserves task 9 by rewriting it from pending to running, without changing its checkpoint {phase: "prepare", attempt: 1} (the scheduler (p. 73)). Every task in this run starts with such a reservation commit. The prepare phase renders the system prompt and tool list and commits them as pi.system entry 10, which holds the preamble section and the count tool. The same commit, 4, moves the task to phase request with the model, the thinking level and a cutoff of entry 10. The request phase first commits pi.live.generation = {attempt: 1} (commit 5), then calls models.streamSimple() off the line. The faux stream finished inside the 100 ms throttle window, so no partial was committed. A slower stream would add throttled partial commits here (generation (p. 91)). The response stops with toolUse. Commit 6 is the turn’s pivot. It writes the response as pi.assistant entry 11 and adds its usage to pi.usage. It creates tool task 12, owned by task 9. It lists the call in pi.live.tools. And it moves task 9 to waiting on [12] with policy allSettled src/harness/generation.ts (startToolRound). A crash after commit 6 reopens with the call recorded and its task pending, so the tool will run. A crash before it reopens in phase request, and the model call is simply made again.
nodes.zh: 提交 3 是调度器在工作。它通过把任务 9 从 `pending` 改写为 `running` 来预留它，同时不改动它的检查点 `{phase: "prepare", attempt: 1}`（调度器（p. 73））。这次运行中的每个任务都以这样一次预留提交开始。`prepare` 阶段渲染系统提示词和工具列表，并把它们作为 `pi.system` 条目 10 提交，其中含前言小节和计数工具。同一次提交，也就是提交 4，把任务移到 `request` 阶段，带上模型、思考级别和条目 10 的截断点。`request` 阶段先提交 `pi.live.generation = {attempt: 1}`（提交 5），然后在变更线之外调用 `models.streamSimple()`。faux 流在 100 ms 的节流窗口内就结束了，因此没有提交任何部分。更慢的流会在此处加上经节流的部分提交（生成（p. 91））。响应以 `toolUse` 结束。提交 6 是这个轮次的转折点。它把响应写成 `pi.assistant` 条目 11，并把用量加进 `pi.usage`。它创建工具任务 12，归属于任务 9。它把这次调用列进 `pi.live.tools`。并把任务 9 移到在 `[12]` 上等待，策略为 `allSettled` `src/harness/generation.ts`（`startToolRound`）。在提交 6 之后崩溃，重开时会带着已记录的调用和处于 `pending` 的任务，于是工具会运行。在它之前崩溃，则重开时仍处于 `request` 阶段，模型调用干脆再做一次。

nodes.text: Commits 7–8: intent before effect
nodes.zh: 提交 7–8：先有意图，后有效果

nodes.text: Commit 7 reserves task 12. Its call phase then reads the call from entry 11, resolves the tool, validates the arguments and runs any beforeTool hooks. Then it commits its intent, commit 8, before running any tool code:
nodes.zh: 提交 7 预留任务 12。它的 `call` 阶段接着从条目 11 读出这次调用，解析工具、校验参数，并运行所有 `beforeTool` 钩子。然后它提交自己的意图，也就是提交 8，之后才运行任何工具代码：

nodes.text: tool task 12 after commit 8 research/capture/sqlite-rows-midrun.txt JSON
nodes.zh: 提交 8 之后的工具任务 12 `research/capture/sqlite-rows-midrun.txt` `JSON`

nodes.text: The tasks row, read from a second connection while execute() ran; conversationId, version and two boolean flags are cut. count declares no replay, so the stored policy is "unsafe".
nodes.zh: 这是 `tasks` 表的一行，在 `execute()` 运行期间从第二个连接读出；`conversationId`、`version` 和两个布尔标志被略去。`count` 没有声明重放，因此存下的策略是 `"unsafe"`。

nodes.text: This record is the reason a crash mid-tool is recoverable. The execute phase is reached on its own only by recovery. If a later process finds a task in it, the tool may have run, and the stored replay decides between running it again and writing an interrupted error result src/harness/tool.ts. That is exactly what happened to deploy in 1.1 (p. 10).
nodes.zh: 这条记录正是工具执行中途的崩溃可以恢复的原因。`execute` 阶段只有通过恢复才会被独自走到。如果后来的进程发现某个任务处于这个阶段，工具可能已经运行过，而存下的重放策略决定是重新运行它，还是写入一条被中断的错误结果 `src/harness/tool.ts`。1.1 里的 `deploy` 发生的正是这件事（p. 10）。

nodes.text: Commits 9–11: output, then the result
nodes.zh: 提交 9–11：先是输出，然后是结果

nodes.text:
The tool’s output is committed as progress, with a default minimum interval of 100 ms. Commit 9 sets pi.live.tools[0].output to "1
"; commit 10 appends "2
3
". A watcher sees the output grow, and a crash would lose only output since the last successful progress commit. There is no fixed time limit on that gap. When execute() returns, commit 11 appends pi.tool-result entry 13 with content "1
2
3
" and makes task 12 terminal with outcome {status: "completed", result: {entryId: 13}}.
nodes.zh:
工具的输出作为进展提交，默认最小间隔为 100 ms。提交 9 把 `pi.live.tools[0].output` 设为 `"1
"`；提交 10 追加 `"2
3
"`。观察者看到输出在增长，而崩溃只会丢失上一次成功进展提交之后的输出。这个间隔没有固定的时间上限。当 `execute()` 返回时，提交 11 追加 `pi.tool-result` 条目 13，内容为 `"1
2
3
"`，并把任务 12 变为终态，`outcome` 为 `{status: "completed", result: {entryId: 13}}`。

nodes.title:
ONE ANSWERED INPUT, COMMITS 9–17
S E Q U E N C E
nodes.caption: Commits 9–17 carry the tool output, the result, a second generation and the answer. Amber arrows are task-only commits: reservations, and the move to request with no prompt change.
nodes.zh_caption: 提交 9–17 承载工具输出、结果、第二次生成以及答案。琥珀色的箭头是只涉及任务的提交：预留，以及在提示词没有变化时移到 `request`。

nodes.text: Commits 9–17 carry the tool output, the result, a second generation and the answer. Amber arrows are task-only commits: reservations, and the move to request with no prompt change.
nodes.zh: 提交 9–17 承载工具输出、结果、第二次生成以及答案。琥珀色的箭头是只涉及任务的提交：预留，以及在提示词没有变化时移到 `request`。

nodes.text: Commits 12–17: the second generation and the answer
nodes.zh: 提交 12–17：第二次生成与答案

nodes.text: Task 12 is terminal, so task 9’s wait is over. Commit 12 reserves it in phase tools. That phase is where queued writes and steering messages sent during the tool round would be placed (the inbox (p. 84)). It then hands the run over: commit 13 creates generation 14, moves pi.live.run.taskId to 14, clears the tool round, and ends task 9 completed with result: {entryId: 11}src/harness/generation.ts (finishToolRound). Generation 14 repeats the first one’s phases with one difference. Its prepare phase finds the prompt and tools unchanged, so it appends no pi.system entry, and commit 15 only moves the task to request. System entries are positional deltas, sent only when something changed (the system prompt (p. 115)). Commit 16 marks the attempt in pi.live, and the model answers with stop reason stop. Commit 17 finishes everything at once. It appends the answer as pi.assistant entry 15 and settles submission 8 done with answer: 15. It makes task 14 terminal, deletes pi.live.run and pi.live.generation, so the conversation is idle again, and adds the second response’s tokens to pi.usage. The Submissions component sees the settled record in the commit’s publication and resolves the host’s wait().
nodes.zh: 任务 12 已是终态，所以任务 9 的等待结束。提交 12 在 `tools` 阶段预留它。这个阶段正是工具轮次期间排队的写入和引导消息会被安放的地方（收件箱（p. 84））。接着它把运行交接出去：提交 13 创建生成任务 14，把 `pi.live.run.taskId` 移到 14，清空工具轮次，并以 `result: {entryId: 11}` 让任务 9 以 `completed` 结束 `src/harness/generation.ts`（`finishToolRound`）。生成任务 14 重复第一次生成的各个阶段，只有一处不同。它的 `prepare` 阶段发现提示词和工具都没有变，因此不追加 `pi.system` 条目，提交 15 只把任务移到 `request`。系统条目是按位置发送的增量，只在有变化时才发（系统提示词（p. 115））。提交 16 在 `pi.live` 中标记这次尝试，模型以停止原因 `stop` 给出答案。提交 17 一次性结束所有事情。它把答案追加为 `pi.assistant` 条目 15，并把提交项 8 结算为 `done`、`answer` 为 15。它把任务 14 变为终态，删除 `pi.live.run` 和 `pi.live.generation`，于是会话重新空闲，并把第二个响应的 token 数加入 `pi.usage`。提交项组件在这次提交的发布中看到那条已结算的记录，于是 resolve 掉宿主的 `wait()`。

nodes.text: The user’s text is safe from commit 2; a resubmit with the same requestId cannot duplicate it. A tool’s intent is committed (commit 8) before any of its code runs, so recovery always knows a call may have started. No commit leaves an answer without its submission settled, or a tool call without a task. Kill the process after any row and it reopens knowing what to do next.
nodes.zh: 从提交 2 起，用户的文本就是安全的；用相同的 `requestId` 重新提交，不会把它复制一份。工具的意图在任何工具代码运行之前就已被提交（提交 8），因此恢复时总能知道某次调用可能已经开始。没有哪次提交会让答案悬在提交项未结算的状态，也没有哪次提交会让工具调用没有任务。在任何一行之后杀掉进程，重开时它都知道下一步该做什么。
